items.title: Texas Senate market analysis shows sweeping Paxton contracts below 51 cents would have cost about 124,000 dollars, AmuseOnX reports
items.content_text: - **Texas Senate market analysis shows sweeping Paxton contracts below 51 cents would have cost about 124,000 dollars, AmuseOnX reports** — An analysis of Polymarket's Texas Senate market, where James Talarico traded near 65 cents against Ken Paxton near 35 cents, estimated that sweeping every Paxton contract offered below 51 cents on October 26 would have cost about 124,000 dollars for roughly 311,000 contracts. The analysis argued that sustaining a price costs far more than briefly touching one in a thin order book. ([AmuseOnX](https://newsletter.amuseonx.com/p/how-to-rig-a-prediction-market))
